verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that the MCP server separates read tools from write and delete tools, so an agent can be approved for reads only [customer-io-docs-10]. That is per-category tool approval in the AI client, not a scoped credential. The documented App API is used both to send messages and to fetch data, with no read-only key scope shown [customer-io-docs-23]. Integration API keys are described as data-in keys, not analytics-read keys [customer-io-docs-28]. Missing for 10: documented ability to mint read-only or scoped API keys, permission scopes that block sending, contractor/agent credential management, independent corroboration.
